input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: Searches for most-favoured-nation / pricing-parity language ("favorable", "favourable", "most favored", "best price", "competitive offer", "discount") returned no hits, and the two candidate sections contain no parity obligation: § 4.1 Charges simply provides that charges are set in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, and § 14.16 Freedom of Action expressly confirms each party may enter similar agreements with others — the opposite of an MFN or exclusivity commitment. The agreement therefore imposes no obligation on Bluefly to extend IBM terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, which meets the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer). No IBM-granted MFN in our favour exists either, but that is an upside item to negotiate commercially, not a deviation under this rule. No redline required.
